item.title: AI Pipeline — Technical Model for Audit
item.lead: The technical section can be upgraded to an auditable model architecture.

blocks.text: A generic system can be described in six auditable steps: (1) intake and context building, (2) retrieval from CRM, (3) prompt construction, (4) model generation, (5) human review, and (6) dispatch. Human responsibility for review and dispatch remains complete. Not every system has all steps, and the order may vary.

Verifiable audit fields include model ID, prompt template, context used, generation output, human modifications, dispatch account, and timestamp. This allows a retrospective investigation to determine how a message was created.

Product documentation from Supercreator describes AI that conducts chats in the creator's voice, sells content, and approaches fans at specific moments. This is strong evidence for the existence of such functions, not for universal use.

blocks.label: TECHNICAL CORE
blocks.text: Message provenance is more important than merely the question of whether “AI” was used somewhere.
